name: Grid Pulse
description: A 3×3 grid of dots that pulse in a diagonal wave from top-left to bottom-right

variations.name: default
variations.description: Nine dots arranged in a 3×3 grid light up and fade in a rolling diagonal wave, top-left to bottom-right

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels (within the 100×100 viewBox)

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of dots per row and column (n × n grid)
